reuse.why: Reuses the shared getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, but writes the rule inline in the preview instead of putting it in the existing getScheduledAmount helper.

duplication.why: Deepens an inline nested ternary that is already copied at api-models, forecast-schedules and schedule-template, so the worst-case logic now differs between copies instead of being shared.

placement.why: The amount rule belongs in shared/schedules.ts's getScheduledAmount; it is added inside computeSchedulePreviewTransactions' mapping instead.

scope.why: Touches only the preview amount, one import and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Only the preview applies the approximate worst case while forecast, budget templates, api-models and posting still compute the amount their own way, so the planned amount now depends on which screen asks; the triple-nested ternary is hard to read.

bypasses_abstraction.where: computeSchedulePreviewTransactions in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts decides the amount inline rather than via getScheduledAmount in the same file.

disguised_duplication.where: The range branch is the existing inline copy left in place, not a disguised one.

one_place.where: The approximate rule is added only in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions (shared/schedules.ts); forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, budget/schedule-template.ts, server/api-models.ts and schedules/app.ts keep their own amount computations.
